{
  "name": "@playlovetoys/design-system",

  "description": "Portable visual foundations, primitives, composite patterns and cross-platform renderers for Play, love & Toys.",

  "scripts": {
    "build:demo": "tailwindcss -i ./demo/demo.css -o ./demo/dist.css --minify",

    "build:themes": "node scripts/build-themes.mjs",
    "check:css": "stylelint \"src/patterns.css\" \"src/primitives.css\" \"src/typography.css\" \"src/base.css\" \"src/utilities.css\" \"src/geometry.css\"",
    "check:themes": "node scripts/check-theme-rules.mjs"
  },
  "files": [
    "src",

    "adapters",
    "contracts",
    "renderers",
    "demo",
    "docs",

  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.css",
    "./tokens": "./src/tokens.css",
    "./tokens/*": "./src/tokens/*",
    "./typography": "./src/typography.css",
    "./geometry": "./src/geometry.css",
    "./utilities": "./src/utilities.css",

    "./renderers/liquid/*": "./renderers/liquid/*",

    "./base": "./src/base.css",
    "./themes/*": "./themes/*.css"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "daisyui": ">=5.7.8 <6",
    "tailwindcss": ">=4 <5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tailwindcss/cli": ">=4 <5",

    "jsdom": "^29.1.1",
    "stylelint": "^17.16.0",

  }
}

name: daisyUI conformance

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  conformance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm run check

.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml::deplo.name: deploy-docs.yml
.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml::deplo.source_code:
name: Deploy docs to Cloudflare Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: deploy-docs
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      deployments: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: npm
      - run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip
      - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run docs:build:all
      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: pages deploy site --project-name=plt-docs
